record_type_quote: This paper is a replication and extension of a prior study that examines the factors influencing employees’ willingness to participate in corporate ventures.

targets.evidence_quote: In this work, we replicate and extend the study by Monsen et al. (2010) that simultaneously considers financial and non-financial factors as motivators for employee participation in CVs.
targets.outcome_quote: Our replication results largely support prior findings and indicate that the extra effort required for participating in a corporate venture is the most important factor driving employees’ decision.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Overall verdict largely supports prior findings; no explicit contrast in available abstract. New extensions are not failures of original results.
